title: RAGalyst: Automated Human-Aligned Agentic Evaluation for Domain-Specific RAG

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing evaluation datasets using different LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, and Qwen3-30B) and cross-evaluating each dataset with all three models to determine if an LLM assigns higher scores (Answer Correctness, Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy) to text it generated itself.
